title: Punt FG%: Player Targets
markdown:
**Summary.** FG% swings more from week to week than any other category, so in our 9-cat head-to-head league it is the cheapest category to give up. A punt FG% team gives up FG% every week and builds to win at least 5 of the other 8 categories. Target high-volume guards and forwards who bring threes, points, assists and FT% but shoot poorly, and buy them at the discount their FG% creates.

## Why FG% swings week to week

FG% changes a lot from game to game. One note says it is the percentage category that varies most from game to game and week to week. FT% is different: it varies most from one year to the next. ([10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=2135), [09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=1472))

Low-volume weeks make this worse. With fewer attempts, each miss moves the percentage more. A week with few games, or with stars resting, can flip FG% no matter how your roster was built. ([10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=2135))

In head-to-head, efficiency is the category that changes most from week to week. One expert prefers steady volume to a small efficiency edge for that reason. Good efficiency on low volume does not matter much either, because FG% in our league is total makes over total attempts. ([09-16](https://youtu.be/2A2JbUN-kc0?t=1744), [09-10](https://youtu.be/W-R1dzem32s?t=1120))

## Why punting one percentage works in H2H

Each week you win or lose 9 categories against one opponent, so 5 wins take the week. Punting FG% means you give up FG% every week and aim for at least 5 of the other 8. Because FG% swings so much week to week, a category you could only win some weeks costs little to give up. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=1472), [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=2135))

Being strong in both FG% and FT% is very hard. If you barely win both, that lead is fragile, and paying for it leaves you short in other categories. Pick one percentage to chase. In a punt FG% build that means FT%, along with threes, points, assists and steals. ([07-15](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=1264))

Players with outlier FG% tend to regress, and a small drop can wipe out most of their edge. A punt FG% team does not need those players at all. Leave them to balanced managers and spend that money on volume. ([07-07](https://youtu.be/ME-r173X5b0?t=2107), [09-16](https://youtu.be/2A2JbUN-kc0?t=1744))

## How to run it in our auction

On 2026-10-18, spend your main money on the core tier. These are high-usage guards and forwards whose only real flaw is FG%, sometimes with turnovers. Many of them also fit a punt TO build, so you can give up both categories and still aim for 5 of the remaining 7. Do not repeat last season's prices for players our league overpaid. Several of them now cost much less on Yahoo. ([Trae Young](#player/617), [LaMelo Ball](#player/27), [James Harden](#player/219), [Brandon Miller](#player/381), [Derrick White](#player/595), [09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=1472))

Save money for the end of the draft. Many poor-shooting players who add threes, assists, steals or blocks are ranked near the edge of our 144-player pool. They are 1 to 2 USD picks at the end, not mid-round buys. Others sit outside the 144 and belong on your FAB watch list instead. ([Fred VanVleet](#player/570), [Egor Dëmin](#player/133), [Jerami Grant](#player/203), [Herbert Jones](#player/291), [Grayson Allen](#player/13), [De'Anthony Melton](#player/376))

Do not take FT% for granted. FT% varies most from year to year, so a player's FT% last season does not guarantee the same this season. Check your team FT% in the first two weeks. If it is slipping, use trades or FAB to fix it before the 2027-03-04 deadline. ([10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=2135), [07-15](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=1264))

The notes do not disagree on this strategy. They all favour steady volume over a small efficiency edge. One caution remains. The same note that makes FG% the best category to punt also says FT% is the least stable from year to year. So a punt FG% team relies on its least stable category from year to year. ([10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=2135), [09-16](https://youtu.be/2A2JbUN-kc0?t=1744), [09-10](https://youtu.be/W-R1dzem32s?t=1120))

## Playoff weeks and in-season checks

Our playoffs are weeks 19 to 21 and end 2027-03-28. Short weeks make percentages more random, but that hurts a punt FG% team less, because FG% is already given up. What matters more is games played for counting stats. Some targets play only 10 games in our playoff weeks, some have a 2-game week, and some have back-to-backs they may sit. ([10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=2135), [Bam Adebayo](#player/4), [Fred VanVleet](#player/570), [Jabari Smith Jr.](#player/527), [James Harden](#player/219), [LaMelo Ball](#player/27), [Damian Lillard](#player/334))

In the first weeks, check minutes and usage before checking shooting. Several targets need about 30 minutes or a starting role to give the volume this build needs. If a waiver-watch guard wins a starting role at about 27 to 28 minutes, put in a FAB bid at once. ([09-16](https://youtu.be/2A2JbUN-kc0?t=1744), [Trae Young](#player/617), [Jalen Green](#player/208), [Grayson Allen](#player/13), [De'Anthony Melton](#player/376))

## Players

Prices in USD. Yahoo and ESPN: rank and average auction cost for 2026-27.

### Core targets

| Player | Team | Pos | Yahoo rank | Yahoo cost | ESPN rank | ESPN cost | Our league 2025-26 | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Trae Young](#player/617) | WAS | G | 18 | 33.6 | 47 | 33.4 | 44 | Elite assists and FT%, and his only costs are FG% and turnovers, so he is ideal for punt FG% plus punt TO if he keeps 33+ minutes and his usage next to Davis and Dybantsa. |
| [LaMelo Ball](#player/27) | MIN | G | 24 | 30.2 | 22 | 27.2 | 29 | His threes, assists, points and steals all count fully when you punt FG%, but his ankle and the playoff two-game week are reasons to stop at the low end of his range. |
| [Bam Adebayo](#player/4) | MIA | F,C | 26 | 25.4 | 15 | 25.5 | 26 | FG% (44.6% on nearly 16 attempts) is his only weak category, so a punt build loses nothing with him, but watch whether Giannis cuts his rebounds and note Miami's 10 playoff-week games. |
| [Brandon Miller](#player/381) | CHA | F | 39 | 19.2 | 54 | 7.3 | 20 | Threes, points and FT% on high volume at about 43% FG fit punt FG% well, and his usage could grow with LaMelo Ball gone, but check his shoulder in camp before the auction. |
| [James Harden](#player/219) | CLE | G | 31 | 19.4 | 25 | 28.0 | 42 | Elite assists and FT% at about 42% FG make him a natural punt FG% guard, but do not pay last season's price, and keep the 2-game finals week and his minutes alongside Mitchell in mind. |

### Value at price

| Player | Team | Pos | Yahoo rank | Yahoo cost | ESPN rank | ESPN cost | Our league 2025-26 | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Derrick White](#player/595) | BOS | G | 36 | 10.2 | 17 | 18.8 | 30 | FG% is his only weak category, and he adds threes, assists, FT% and blocks that lead guards, but the market has overpaid him, so bid near his Yahoo cost and not last season's price. |
| [Damian Lillard](#player/334) | POR | G | 67 | 5.0 | 70 | 5.6 | not drafted | A cheap source of FT%, threes and assists at about 43.7% FG, with games played as the main risk because of his Achilles and three playoff back-to-backs. |

### Late flyers

| Player | Team | Pos | Yahoo rank | Yahoo cost | ESPN rank | ESPN cost | Our league 2025-26 | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Myles Turner](#player/564) | MIL | C | 101 | 1.0 | 93 | 1.0 | 20 | Blocks and threes from a center with FG% that is low for his position, worth a late buy if he gets about 29 minutes next to Ware. |
| [Jabari Smith Jr.](#player/527) | HOU | F,C | 98 | 1.6 | 110 | 1.1 | 1 | Gives threes and rebounds from a F/C slot with few turnovers at about 44.8% FG, though his 10-game playoff schedule is a minus. |
| [Fred VanVleet](#player/570) | HOU | G | 153 | 1.0 | 74 | 1.7 | 1 | His threes, assists, steals and low turnovers count while his 39% shooting does not, but his knee, rest on back-to-backs and 10 playoff-week games limit him to a late guard pick. |
| [Egor Dëmin](#player/133) | BKN | G | 131 | 0.0 | 121 | 0.6 | not drafted | Projected for about 3 threes a game with some assists at about 40% FG, an end-game pick whose value to hold depends on his starting role and whether his FG% climbs. |
| [Jalen Green](#player/208) | PHX | G,F | 130 | 1.0 | 130 | 1.4 | 9 | Cheap late points and threes for punt FG% and punt TO builds if he gets 30+ minutes and his FT% climbs back toward 80%. |
| [Herbert Jones](#player/291) | NOP | G,F | 134 | - | 194 | 0.0 | 5 | A cheap steals source at about 1.5 a game on low shot volume (about 8 attempts), and a waiver option if nobody drafts him. |
| [Jerami Grant](#player/203) | MEM | F | 193 | 0.0 | 147 | 0.2 | not drafted | Gives about 2.4 threes plus points at about 43.5% FG as a final pick, if he starts and his minutes stay near 29. |

### Waiver watch

| Player | Team | Pos | Yahoo rank | Yahoo cost | ESPN rank | ESPN cost | Our league 2025-26 | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Grayson Allen](#player/13) | CHA | G,F | 187 | 0.0 | 157 | 0.1 | not drafted | Threes, FT% and some steals at about 42% FG, but he ranks outside our 144, so add him through FAB if he starts at about 27 minutes while Knueppel is out. |
| [De'Anthony Melton](#player/376) | GSW | G | 245 | - | 180 | 0.0 | not drafted | Steals (about 1.6) are his one standout category at about 41% FG, so do not draft him, but add him right away if he wins the starting job at about 28 minutes. |

<sub>Built 2026-10-04 with claude-opus-5-5 high.</sub>
